questions.question_text: Match the word: healthy
questions.correct_answer: Being in good physical or mental condition
questions.explanation: Healthy means being well and not ill.

questions.question_text: Match the phrase: junk food
questions.correct_answer: Food that is unhealthy and often contains too much fat, sugar or salt
questions.explanation: Junk food is food with little nutritional value.

questions.question_text: Match the word: vegetable
questions.correct_answer: A plant or part of a plant eaten as food
questions.explanation: Vegetables include carrots, potatoes and spinach.

questions.question_text: Match the word: vitamin
questions.correct_answer: A natural substance needed by the body to stay healthy
questions.explanation: Vitamins help the body grow and work properly.

questions.question_text: Match the word: sunburn
questions.correct_answer: Red and painful skin caused by too much sunlight
questions.explanation: Sunburn happens when the skin receives too much ultraviolet radiation.

questions.question_text: Match the word: sore throat
questions.correct_answer: Pain or irritation in the throat
questions.explanation: A sore throat can make swallowing uncomfortable.

questions.question_text: Match the word: stomachache
questions.explanation: A stomachache is pain felt in the stomach area.

questions.question_text: Match the word: energetic
questions.explanation: Energetic describes someone who feels active and full of energy.

questions.question_text: Eating fruit and vegetables helps you stay ______.
questions.explanation: Healthy means being in good physical condition.

questions.question_text: You should not eat too much ______ because it is bad for your health.
questions.explanation: Junk food usually contains too much fat, sugar or salt.

questions.question_text: Carrots and potatoes are examples of ______.
questions.explanation: Vegetables are important parts of a balanced diet.

questions.question_text: Milk and eggs contain important ______ for our bodies.
questions.explanation: Vitamins help the body stay healthy.

questions.question_text: You should wear a hat to avoid ______ on sunny days.
questions.explanation: Sunburn is skin damage caused by too much sunlight.

questions.question_text: I have a ______, so it hurts when I swallow.
questions.explanation: A sore throat causes pain or irritation when swallowing.

questions.question_text: I ate too much food, and now I have a ______.
questions.explanation: A stomachache is pain in the stomach.

questions.question_text: After doing exercise, I feel active and ______.
questions.explanation: Energetic means having a lot of energy.

questions.question_text: Which food is usually considered junk food?
questions.explanation: Potato chips are often high in salt and fat, so they are considered junk food.

questions.question_text: Which of these is a vegetable?
questions.explanation: A carrot is a vegetable.

questions.question_text: What do vitamins help us do?
questions.explanation: Vitamins help the body grow and function properly.

questions.question_text: What happens when you have sunburn?
options: Your skin becomes red and painful
questions.explanation: Sunburn makes the skin red and painful after too much sun exposure.

questions.question_text: Which expression describes pain in your throat?
questions.explanation: A sore throat is pain or irritation in the throat.

questions.question_text: Which word means 'having a lot of energy'?
questions.explanation: Energetic describes someone who has a lot of energy.

questions.question_text: Which word describes a balanced diet?
options: Eating different kinds of healthy food
questions.explanation: A balanced diet includes different types of food in suitable amounts.

questions.question_text: Which word is closest in meaning to 'fit'?
questions.explanation: Fit means being healthy and physically strong.

questions.question_text: Which symptom is related to coughing?
questions.explanation: A cough is an action or symptom involving sudden air coming from the lungs.

questions.question_text: Which word means a small red mark or spot on the skin?
questions.explanation: A spot can refer to a small mark on the skin.

questions.question_text: Which sentence uses 'balanced' correctly?
options: I eat a balanced diet with different healthy foods.
I balanced a sore throat yesterday.
questions.explanation: Balanced is commonly used in the phrase 'a balanced diet'.

questions.question_text: Which of these is NOT a symptom of illness?
questions.explanation: A vitamin is a nutrient, not a symptom.

questions.question_text: Eating vegetables is important for your ______. (HEALTHY)
questions.explanation: Health is the noun form of healthy.

questions.question_text: My grandfather is very ______ and walks every morning. (ENERGY)
questions.explanation: Energetic is the adjective form related to energy.

questions.question_text: You should eat a ______ diet. (BALANCE)
questions.explanation: Balanced is the adjective form of balance.

questions.question_text: Regular exercise helps you stay ______. (FIT)
questions.explanation: Fit is an adjective describing good physical condition.

questions.question_text: Fruit is a good source of important ______. (VITAMIN)
questions.explanation: Vitamins is the plural form of vitamin.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: Eating too much junk food is very health.
questions.explanation: Unhealthy is the correct adjective to describe something bad for your health.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: I have a stomach throat, so I cannot swallow easily.
questions.explanation: Sore throat is the correct expression for pain in the throat.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: Carrots and potatoes are kinds of vitamins.
questions.explanation: Carrots and potatoes are vegetables, not vitamins.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: After playing football, I feel very energy.
questions.explanation: Energetic is the adjective needed after feel.

questions.question_text: Find and correct the vocabulary mistake: He has a sunburn because he ate too much.
questions.explanation: A stomachache is related to stomach pain after eating too much. Sunburn is caused by too much sunlight.

questions.question_text: After spending all afternoon in the sun without protection, Hoa's skin became red and painful. What happened to her?
questions.explanation: Sunburn occurs when skin receives too much sunlight.

questions.question_text: Minh eats vegetables, fruit, meat and rice in suitable amounts. What kind of diet does he have?
questions.explanation: A balanced diet contains different types of food in suitable amounts.

questions.question_text: Lan feels pain in her stomach after eating too much candy. What does she have?
questions.explanation: A stomachache is pain in the stomach.

questions.question_text: Nam exercises regularly and eats well. He is strong and in good physical condition. Which word describes him?
questions.explanation: Fit means healthy and physically strong.

questions.question_text: After a good night's sleep, Mai feels active and ready to play sports. How does she feel?
questions.explanation: Energetic means feeling active and having plenty of energy.
